confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mexican Pacific resort-city pricing for a July window. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary widely with season and location. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set from the local beer price using a typical bar-to-beer markup, because direct knowledge of those prices is limited. No live listings were checked. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page and was not read directly from the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Mexican Pacific coastal tourist cities, such as Puerto Vallarta and Zihuatanejo, adjusted to run somewhat cheaper than Puerto Vallarta. July is the rainy season, so accommodation anchors assume shoulder-season rates.
